text: Figure 12.4: Alias Name Assignment (CommonStrucure: AliasNameAssignment) Class AliasNameSet Package M2::AUTOSARTemplates::CommonStructure::FlatMap Note This meta-class represents a set of AliasNames. The AliasNameSet can for example be an input to the A2L-Generator. It shall not be used by the RTE generator to generate the MC-Support. In a given instance of AliasNameSet in the bound system there must be at most one aliasName per FlatInstanceDescriptor.
